subject: general
question:
Select the word that is closest in meaning (SYNONYM) to the word given below.

Attune
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 1' **i.e. **'Assimilate'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word** "Attune"** means to make receptive or aware, or to bring into harmony. In Hindi, it can be translated as "मेल खाना" or "सामंजस्य".
 
• The word that is closest in meaning **(synonym) to "Attune"** is: **'Assimilate'.**
 
• **It means to** take in information, ideas, or culture and understand fully, or to bring into harmony. In Hindi, "Assimilate" can be translated as "समाहित करना" or "एकीकृत करना".

Therefore, the **correct answer** is: **'Assimilate'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

• **Estrange -** to cause someone to be no longer friendly or close to another person or group.(अलग करना)
 
• **Disrupt - **to interrupt by causing a disturbance or problem.(बाधा डालना)
